name: Podman in Podman
description: Runs a Podman engine in the dev container. The remote user runs rootless Podman, and sudo runs rootful Podman.

buildah.description: Install buildah from the distribution archive.

skopeo.description: Install skopeo from the distribution archive.

compose.description: Compose tool. podman-compose needs no API service. docker-compose needs the API socket, so this value also starts the socket service of the remote user at container start.

dockerCompat.description: Install podman-docker (a docker command that runs podman), start the API socket service of the remote user at container start, and link /var/run/docker.sock to it. When a different package has /usr/bin/docker, the install skips this option.
